source_anchor.current_behavior: returns true when DISPLAY is nonempty and libX11 is discoverable, without proving XOpenDisplay succeeds

grf_collapse.observed_reality: The exact successful one-file EntityOS artifact can encounter a host where DISPLAY is present and libX11 is loadable but the X endpoint cannot be opened.
grf_collapse.preferred_hypothesis: The graphical availability predicate is weaker than the actual visual-shell precondition and can route normal boot into a known-unavailable X11 path.
grf_collapse.strongest_counterhypothesis: A supported graphical host contract may intentionally require every nonempty DISPLAY to be valid, making this environment outside the accepted compatibility set.
grf_collapse.discriminator: Run a deterministic regression in which DISPLAY is present but XOpenDisplay fails; require a declared fail-closed/headless result rather than treating environment presence as graphical availability.

release_consequence: Does not invalidate the successful self-hosted exact-head workflow, but whole-machine acceptance remains false and supported-host behavior for stale/unreachable DISPLAY is not yet explicitly gated.
next_executable_action: In the next product-changing cycle, replace or strengthen graphical_display_available with a real short-lived XOpenDisplay probe (closing it immediately) or an equivalent explicit host capability probe; add a deterministic stale/unreachable-DISPLAY regression covering both first-start and post-grant no-argument launch; then rebuild and rerun the exact one-file EntityOS gates.

unusual_experiment_accounting.reason: This is ordinary exact-artifact compatibility verification of the current session environment, not a second novelty intervention.
